sections.content: Latest articles and real estate tips

In today's fast-moving real estate market, creating rental contracts professionally and quickly is essential for every owner and investor. Whether you manage one property or an entire portfolio, understanding contract fundamentals saves time and reduces legal risk.

Traditional property management relies on paperwork and manual follow-up, which leads to contract delays, difficulty tracking tenant data, and weak documentation of agreements. These challenges make it harder for owners to maintain operational efficiency.

Digital property management means using electronic systems to store property, owner, and tenant data, and to create and document contracts through accredited platforms such as Ejar. This approach provides clearer visibility, faster decisions, and secure documentation for every step in the rental cycle.
Managers who adopt digital property management save up to 60% of the time spent on administrative tasks, reduce human error, and significantly improve tenant satisfaction.

residential.title: Documented Electronic Residential Rental Contract
residential.description: Create your residential rental contract online, documented via the official Ejar network in minutes — clear fees and certified steps that protect landlord and tenant, and we follow up on WhatsApp to finalize it.
features: Officially documented via the Ejar network
No sign-up — just fill in your details and we continue with you
Done in minutes
A certified contract that protects everyone's rights
residential.eligibility: Landlords and tenants (individuals and businesses) and licensed brokers.
residential.responseTime: Draft within working hours; documented after your review.
steps: Fill in the property and unit details
Enter the parties' details (landlord and tenant)
Financial details, rent amount and term
Terms and conditions
Review, submit the order, then pay
Receive the contract draft on WhatsApp for review
Contract documented in Ejar after you review the draft
requirements: Valid national ID or residency for the parties
Title deed or proof of the right to lease
Property details (deed number and electricity meter number)
Agreement on the rent amount and contract term

faq.a: Yes — it is registered and documented through the official Ejar network and serves as an enforceable instrument that protects rights.

faq.q: Do I need an account to create a contract?
faq.a: No. Fill in your details directly with no sign-up, and we follow up on WhatsApp to finalize the documentation.

faq.q: When is the contract documented in Ejar?
faq.a: After payment we send you the contract draft on WhatsApp for review; the contract is documented in Ejar only after you review the draft — usually within working hours the same day.
Fees are shown in the “Service fee” card on this page and in the price sheet inside the wizard, and include the Ejar platform fee. Document surcharge or meter transfer fees apply only when needed.

landing.title: Lessor change service
landing.description: Has the property moved to a new owner? We transfer every tenancy contract linked to the old deed to the new deed on the Ejar platform in two steps: upload both deeds and enter the new owner's details, then pay the service fee.
landing.feeNote: A flat fee per request, inclusive of all charges.
landing.eligibility: The new owner or their agent, and licensed real-estate brokerages.
landing.responseTime: Within one business day after payment and complete documents.
features: All contracts linked to the old deed are moved at once
No account needed — your mobile number and a verification code
A flat, transparent fee per request
Track the request with the order number and mobile
steps: Upload the old owner's deed and the new owner's deed
Enter the new owner's ID number and date of birth
Acknowledge that linked contracts move to the new deed
Verify your mobile and pay the service fee
We complete the transfer on Ejar and notify you
requirements: A clear copy of the old owner's deed
A clear copy of the new owner's deed
The new owner's date of birth

faq.a: Every contract linked to the old deed is transferred to the new deed under the new owner, with no need to recreate it.
No — your mobile number and a verification code are enough to submit and track the request.
A flat fee per request shown before payment, inclusive of all charges.
Processing starts once payment is complete and the documents are in order; you are notified on completion.
